name: One baseline per device
summary: Every check that ever passed is held to; a check outside a run's scope is not asked, rather than kept in a second baseline.
why: Two baselines would be two truths about one phone.

name: The conveyor refuses what cannot work
summary: Each mistake that cost a try becomes a refusal with a reason: a kernel that is not an EFI program, a listening test without the word that the microphone is placed.
why: A refusal costs a second; a lost try costs a reboot and a wrong theory.
